title: NTI-Modern Impression-camping
description: Decorative items related to outdoor camping have been added. The items in this mod do not have specific functions and serve only as decorations
body:
![ all items](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d4d480814e6441f127ef33f184d41ad36b8380f4.png)
This mod adds decorative items related to camping to Minecraft. All items have no specific functional use and can only be used purely for decoration. All items are composed of OBJ models
Este mod añade objetos decorativos relacionados con el camping a Minecraft, todos los artículos no tienen funciones específicas para usar y solo sirven como decoración, todos los objetos están compuestos por modelos obj.
